'''''The High Republic: Defy the Storm''''' is a ''[[Star Wars: The High Republic]]'' young-adult novel by [[Justina Ireland]] and [[Tessa Gratton]]. It was published as part of [[Phase III: Trials of the Jedi|Phase III]] of the multimedia project on [[March 5]], [[2024]].
